segments.text: tumne suna, ye Nexon 9.9 second mein 0 se 100 pakad leti hai — aur teri gaadi abhi tak first gear dhoond rahi hai!
1.5-litre turbo engine mein 81 kW ka dum. Signal green hua, aur tu gone!
Torque poore 245 N⋅m. Overtake ho ya chadhaai — Nexon peeche nahi atti bhai.

Daam? Around 7.37 se 14.22 lakh, estimate hai. Par asli paisa-vasool hai Creative variant, around 10 lakh mein — 360-degree camera, cruise control, automatic climate control aur alloy wheels. Sab kuch, bina jeb kaate!
Log Nexon ko simple bolte hain. Bhai, itne feature itne daam mein — simple nahi, ye toh smart move hai!
Toh aap batao comment mein — Nexon logay, ya abhi bhi soch rahey ho? Follow karo, roz nayi gaadi ki information yahin milegi!
